clock_boundary: Parse inputs and expected values and initialize before timing. Time computation plus the complete numerical predicate. Serialize afterward.
analysis: Keep all 12 samples per system; report median and range, candidate/baseline ratios within each mode, and all paired per-round ratios. Do not trim or stop adaptively.
failure_policy: Abort on timeout, nonzero exit, wrong complete stdout, extra/missing CSV time, hash or environment drift, surviving descendants, or competing measurement activity. Retain partial records and report the failure; do not silently retry.
balance: Two six-row Williams cycles. Each system occupies every position twice; each directed within-row adjacent pair occurs twice. Each candidate precedes its baseline six times and follows it six times. Alternate workload order by round.
source_scope: This plan compares freshly built committed production sources. Earlier WAT probe timings are separate evidence.
